description_en: Retrieves the list of apps in a cluster
name: DescribeContainerApps

parameters.help_en: The application value to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的应用值，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: field_value

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the container cluster. Note: This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the service returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh: 容器集群的ID。注意：此参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务返回400错误
parameters.name: cluster_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
